title: Invertibility of the ordinary continuous-coefficient proper projection mate
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$, separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes $Z_0,Y_0$ and a proper $k_0$-morphism $p_0:Z_0\to Y_0$. Let $Z,Y,p$ be their geometric base changes. For any source and target locally finite realizations $R,S$, residue-unit instances, tensor data $A:\mathrm{At}(R)$ and $B:\mathrm{At}(S)$ [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization], prime-unit witness and normalized proper adjunction Comparison $C$ for $p$ [lem-sf-adic-proper-adjunction-realization], let $M,N$ be ordinary section-module derived objects on $Z,Y$. Assume both are bounded constructible in the exact essential-image sense of boundedConstructible [def-sf-native-adic-realization-data]. Then the actual ordinary counit mate properOrdinaryProjection [def-sf-native-proper-projection-comparison-data], formed using $C.operations$ and $C.tensor$, is an isomorphism. The assertion concerns ordinary modules, with no Frobenius data or native operation comparison in its conclusion.

proof.text: Use R.image and S.image to lift boundedConstructible inputs to common-stage objects, with ordinary comparison isomorphisms. Choose the compositum of their coefficient stages. The finite-stage tensor/counit normalization and finite rational proper projection invertibility imply invertibility of the common-stage proper counit mate by the generic adjunction projection square. Naturality transports this along the stage-enlargement isomorphisms. No arbitrary operation package is postulated.

Reverse the tensor normalization of C, then apply the generic adjunction projection square with C.counit. The ordinary image of the common-stage invertible projection is conjugated to the ordinary proper projection on the lifted inputs. Cancel the tensor and pull/push isomorphisms. Naturality of the counit projection transports along the ordinary lifting isomorphisms to M,N. The proof is complete from the two finite-stage statements.

proof_origin.place: Finite coefficient invertibility and comparison factored out; explicit projection square and naturality transports in U1 Lean proof.

theorem properOrdinaryProjection_isIso [IsProper p]
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l
      (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    (S : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l
      (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    [∀ x : (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber,
      Invertible (l : (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber,
      Invertible (l : (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber.residueField y)]
    (A : At l (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber R)
    (B : At l (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber S)
    (hl : IsUnit (l : AlgebraicClosure k₀))
    (C : Proper.Comparison l (NativeBaseChange.geometricMap k₀ p) R S
      (AlgebraicClosure k₀) hl A B)
    (M : DerivedCategory (modules l (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber R))
    (N : DerivedCategory (modules l (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber S))
    (hM : boundedConstructible l (Z ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber R M)
    (hN : boundedConstructible l (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber S N) :
    IsIso (properOrdinaryProjection k₀ l p R S A B C.operations C.tensor M N)
